decision: Keep candidate atlas for continued development. Final artwork/AAA acceptance withheld.
findings: The replacement colour atlas removes the known repeating directional waves. Its quieter broad habitat variation is a better foundation for the catchment.
The closer three-quarter campsite composition remains a clear improvement: car/roofbox, camper sides and solar layout are recognisable.

Dark wavy shapes in the foreground and on the left slope remain substantially similar despite the quiet new colour map. They must not be blamed on the removed albedo pattern; shadow projection and repeated normal response remain plausible contributors.
This frame does not establish a renderer defect. A controlled native comparison is necessary to isolate geometry, normals and shadows.
The main remaining art weaknesses are bare foreground, thin isolated groundcover, repeated tree form and bark, flat vehicle/canvas materials and weak atmospheric separation.
The contextual panel still covers part of the solar/river area and the bottom navigation hides nearby litter. Root is addressing panel visibility separately.
diagnostic_scope: No shared runtime or scene edited. Do not substitute counters or an HTTP success for the outstanding art judgement.
